nindian-society-50-11.s: The Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 was brought into force:
o: On one date for all States, 29 December 2007
On one date for all States, 1 January 2008
Only in Union Territories from 29 December 2007
nindian-society-50-11.x: The Act was brought into force state by state from 29 December 2007, not on a single date for all States.

ne742dfa9b91.s: Which concept is a focus of the National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011?
o: Institutionalisation of all elderly in old age homes
Welfare only for elderly in joint families
ne742dfa9b91.x: NPSC 2011 focuses on ageing in place, along with income security, homecare, health insurance and harsh punishment for elder abuse.

n591c700cfd9.s: As originally launched in 2017, the Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana offered an assured pension of:
n591c700cfd9.x: PMVVY offered an assured pension of 8% for 10 years, with a maximum purchase price of Rs 7.5 lakh and maximum pension of Rs 5,000 a month.

nee8016bfaf7.s: What happened to the Senior Citizens (Amendment) Bill, 2019, which proposed covering in-laws and grandchildren?
o: It was enacted as an Act in 2019
It was enacted as an Act in 2021
It was passed by Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha in 2020
nee8016bfaf7.x: The 2019 Bill proposed removing the Rs 10,000 cap and covering in-laws and grandchildren, but it was not passed.

n0c7f22d26c7.s: Elder Line, the National Helpline for Senior Citizens under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, has the number:
n0c7f22d26c7.x: Elder Line 14567 is the National Helpline for Senior Citizens, operated under MoSJE; it is not limited to pension disbursement.

na049772104c.s: The National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011 drew attention to destitution among which group?
o: Elderly persons in old age homes
na049772104c.x: NPSC 2011 backed 'ageing in place' and highlighted destitution among the rural elderly.

n01c013bf1fc.s: In Finance Commission formulas, population carries a weight of about:
n01c013bf1fc.x: Population carries 15–25% weight in Finance Commission formulas, which is why southern States that controlled population fear losing out.

n1142cc17f04.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about fertility as per SRS 2024?
o: India's TFR has stayed below 2.1 for the fifth year
Delhi has the lowest TFR at 1.2
Bihar has the lowest TFR among States
n1142cc17f04.x: Bihar is the highest-fertility State, not the lowest; Delhi (1.2) has the lowest TFR.

n83b38c38d82.s: About how many new working-age people does India need jobs for every year?
n83b38c38d82.x: About 9.7 million new working-age people enter each year; the demographic dividend pays off only if they are employed.

n91f91bffe95.s: The elderly account for about what share of hospitalisation spending in India?
n91f91bffe95.x: The elderly account for about 30–35% of hospitalisation spending; ageing does not remove the need for long-term health expenditure.

n739c6e65c31.s: On which date was NALSA v. Union of India delivered?
n739c6e65c31.x: NALSA was delivered on 15 April 2014 by Justices K.S. Radhakrishnan and A.K. Sikri.

n60260cc08a4.s: According to NALSA v. Union of India, a person's gender identity is:
n60260cc08a4.x: NALSA held that gender identity is self-determined, not dependent on biology or State verification.

n59259e05974.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about State measures for transgender persons?
o: Tamil Nadu set up a Transgender Welfare Board in 2008
The Thirunangaigal app was launched in 2021
The Thirunangaigal app for ID registration is a Kerala measure
Sthree Suraksha for EWS women and transgender persons is a Kerala scheme
n59259e05974.x: The Thirunangaigal app (2021) is a Tamil Nadu measure, not a Kerala one.

n7749eb68457.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: K. Prithika Yashini – First transgender judge
Manabi Bandyopadhyay – First transgender college principal
Madhu Bai Kinnar – First transgender college principal
n7749eb68457.x: Manabi Bandyopadhyay became the first transgender college principal in 2015. Joyita Mondal was the first transgender judge, Prithika Yashini the first police sub-inspector and Madhu Bai Kinnar the first mayor.

n38b22e10554.s: Who became India's first transgender MLA, in Madhya Pradesh in 1998?
n38b22e10554.x: Shabnam Mausi became the first transgender MLA (MP, 1998); Madhu Bai Kinnar was the first transgender mayor (Raigarh, 2015).

nedab276c32d.s: The definition of a transgender person under the 2019 Act includes:
o: Only persons who have undergone sex reassignment surgery
Only persons certified by a medical board
Only persons of the hijra community
nedab276c32d.x: The 2019 definition includes persons with intersex variations, trans men and women, genderqueer persons and socio-cultural identities such as kinner, hijra, aravani and jogta.

ne0960423d41.s: Transgender persons have demanded which type of reservation, cutting across SC, ST, OBC and General categories?
o: Reservation only under the women's quota
ne0960423d41.x: The community seeks horizontal reservation across SC, ST, OBC and General; NALSA's SEBC treatment resembled a vertical OBC-type quota.

new.s: Under the Senior Citizens Act, 2007, abandonment of a senior citizen is punishable with imprisonment up to:
new.x: Abandoning a senior citizen attracts up to 3 months' jail and/or a Rs 5,000 fine.

new.s: Under the Senior Citizens Act, 2007, how many old age homes must be set up at minimum?
new.x: The Act requires at least one old age home in every district.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Appellate Tribunal under the Senior Citizens Act, 2007 is headed by the:
new.x: The Appellate Tribunal works at district level under the District Collector; the Maintenance Tribunal is at sub-division level under the RDO/Sub-Collector.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Senior Citizens Act, 2007:
1. The maximum maintenance is Rs 10,000 per month.
2. A maintenance case must be decided within 90 days.
3. The duty to maintain parents falls only on biological children.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: biological, adopted and step-children and legal heirs must maintain parents.

new.s: The National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE), 2010-11, is run by the:
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
new.x: NPHCE belongs to MoHFW, not MoSJE; Section 20 of the 2007 Act on medical care is its basis.

new.s: How many principal areas of intervention did the National Policy on Older Persons, 1999 identify?
new.x: NPOP 1999 (MoSJE) defined an older person as 60+ and listed 14 principal areas of intervention, including health care and nutrition.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about IGNOAPS:
1. It is administered by the Ministry of Rural Development.
2. The Centre's share has been revised every year since 2007.
3. It pays Rs 200 a month to those aged 60-79 and Rs 500 to those aged 80 and above.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the Centre's share has been frozen at Rs 200 since 2007.

new.s: The Ayushman Vay Vandana card provides a health cover of:
new.x: The Ayushman Vay Vandana card (AB-PMJAY, 2024) gives Rs 5 lakh health cover to all aged 70+, irrespective of income.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: IGNOAPS – Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
new.x: PMVVY is a pension scheme run through LIC. Vayoshri is run with ALIMCO, Vay Vandana is under AB-PMJAY and IGNOAPS is under MoRD.

new.s: Under SAGE (Seniorcare Ageing Growth Engine), elder-care start-ups can get equity support of up to:
new.x: SAGE, under AVYAY, offers up to Rs 1 crore equity for elder-care start-ups, with the Government's stake below 49%.

new.s: Elder Line 14567 is a component of which scheme?
new.x: Elder Line is one of the four components of AVYAY, along with IPSrC, State Action Plan and RVY.

new.s: Technical support for Elder Line is provided by:
new.x: Elder Line, under MoSJE, gets technical support from Tata Trusts and NSE Foundation and runs with State emergency response centres.

new.s: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) was launched on:
new.x: NSAP was launched on 15 August 1995 under the Ministry of Rural Development.

new.s: Under the Annapurna component of NSAP, eligible seniors not getting IGNOAPS receive free food grains of:
new.x: Annapurna gives 10 kg of free food grains a month to seniors eligible for, but not receiving, IGNOAPS.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NSAP components?
o: NFBS is a component of Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana
IGNDPS covers persons with 80% or more disability
NFBS gives a lump sum of Rs 20,000 on the death of the primary breadwinner
new.x: NFBS is a component of NSAP, not AVYAY; the other three statements are correct.

new.s: The Mukhyamantri Vriddhajan Pension Yojana, a universal old-age pension with no income bar, belongs to:
new.x: Bihar's Mukhyamantri Vriddhajan Pension Yojana (2019) covers all aged 60+ without another pension: Rs 400 (60-79), Rs 500 (80+).

new.s: In June 2024 (G.O. 43), Andhra Pradesh raised the NTR Bharosa old-age pension to:
new.x: The NTR Bharosa old-age pension was raised from Rs 3,000 to Rs 4,000 a month on 13 June 2024.

new.s: Under the NTR Bharosa Pension, the minimum age for old-age pension for ST beneficiaries is:
new.x: The minimum age is 60 years in general, but 50 years for ST beneficiaries.

new.s: The Longitudinal Ageing Study in India (LASI), Wave 1, was conducted by:
new.x: LASI Wave 1 (2017-18) was conducted by IIPS, Mumbai under MoHFW; its report was released in 2021.

new.s: According to the India Ageing Report 2023, the elderly will outnumber children (0-14) by:
new.x: The UNFPA–IIPS India Ageing Report 2023 projects the elderly to exceed children aged 0-14 by 2046.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the India Ageing Report 2023?
o: It was prepared by HelpAge India
It was prepared by UNFPA with IIPS
It flags feminisation of ageing as a key challenge
It flags ruralisation of ageing as a key challenge
new.x: The report was prepared by UNFPA with IIPS, not HelpAge India; feminisation and ruralisation are among its key challenges.

new.s: LASI Wave 1 covered persons of which age group and their spouses?
new.x: LASI covered about 72,250 persons aged 45+ and their spouses.

new.s: T.R. Malthus published 'An Essay on the Principle of Population' in:
new.x: Malthus's Essay on the Principle of Population appeared in 1798.

new.s: According to Malthus, food supply grows in:
new.x: Malthus held that food grows in arithmetic progression (1, 2, 3, 4) while population grows in geometric progression (1, 2, 4, 8).

new.s: In Malthusian theory, moral restraint such as late marriage and celibacy is a:
new.x: Preventive checks lower the birth rate (moral restraint); positive checks such as famine and war raise the death rate.

new.s: The theory of optimum population was propounded by:
new.x: Edwin Cannan gave the optimum population theory and rejected Malthus's view of an inherent tendency to overpopulation.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Demographic transition theory – Warren Thompson and Frank Notestein
new.x: Demographic transition theory is linked to Thompson and Notestein. Optimum population is Cannan's; late marriage is a preventive check and famine a positive check.

new.s: As per Census 2011, what share of India's population was rural?
new.x: Census 2011 counted about 121.09 crore people, 68.9% of them rural.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's share of India's population (2025-26) is about:
new.x: AP has 495.77 lakh people, about 4.09% of India, ranking 10th.

new.s: India launched the world's first national family planning programme in:
new.x: India was the first country to launch a national family planning programme, in 1952.

new.s: India's early family planning programme had little rural impact mainly because it was:
new.x: The early approach was clinic-based and concentrated in cities, so it reached few rural people.

new.s: The shift from population control to individual well-being and reproductive health followed which conference?
new.x: The ICPD at Cairo in 1994 moved the focus from population control to individual well-being and reproductive health.

new.s: India adopted the target-free approach in family planning, dropping method-specific contraceptive targets, in:
new.x: In April 1996 India dropped method-specific contraceptive targets and adopted a target-free approach.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Population Policy 2000:
1. Its long-term objective is a stable population by 2050.
2. Its immediate objective is to meet the unmet need for contraception.
3. Its medium-term objective is to reach TFR 2.1 by 2010.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the long-term goal is a stable population by 2045.

new.s: The National Commission on Population, set up in May 2000, is chaired by the:
new.x: The Commission is chaired by the Prime Minister, with the Chief Ministers of all States/UTs as members.

new.s: Which effect of population growth on land is commonly cited?
new.x: Population growth puts pressure on resources and leads to smaller land holdings.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's two-child norm for local body elections, removed by Bills in 2024, dated from:
new.x: AP's two-child norm for local polls dated from 1994; the AP Panchayat Raj and Municipal Laws (Amendment) Bills, 2024 removed it.

new.s: AP's draft Population Management Policy (March 2026) offers an incentive of what amount for a second or third child?
new.x: The draft policy moves from control to management and offers Rs 25,000 for a second or third child.

new.s: The Quality of Life for Elderly Index (2021) was prepared by the Institute for Competitiveness at the request of:
new.x: The Institute for Competitiveness prepared the index at the request of the Economic Advisory Council to the PM.

new.s: Under the Quality of Life for Elderly Index (2021), which category–top performer pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: Chandigarh topped the Union Territories, not Delhi; the other pairs are correct.

new.s: Wave 1 of the Longitudinal Ageing Study in India (LASI) was conducted in:
new.x: LASI Wave 1 was conducted in 2017-18 by IIPS for MoHFW and released in 2021.

new.s: About what percentage of the elderly in India depend on others?
new.x: About 70% of the elderly depend on others; 78% have no pension.

new.s: The phenomenon of more elderly women, especially widows, among the aged population is called:
new.x: Feminisation of ageing refers to the growing share of women, many of them widows, among the elderly.

new.s: Which of the following was a direction of the Supreme Court in NALSA v. Union of India?
o: Certificate on a medical board's recommendation
Separate public toilets and health facilities
new.x: NALSA directed separate public toilets, health facilities and welfare schemes, and SEBC treatment (a vertical quota).

new.s: Which case declared privacy a fundamental right under Article 21?
new.x: A nine-judge bench in K.S. Puttaswamy (2017) held privacy to be a fundamental right under Article 21.

new.s: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018) is known for:
o: Decriminalising same-sex relations under Section 377 IPC
new.x: Navtej (2018) decriminalised same-sex relations under Section 377 IPC.

new.s: In Supriyo v. Union of India (October 2023), the five-judge bench by a 3:2 majority:
o: Refused legal recognition of same-sex marriage, leaving it to Parliament
new.x: Supriyo refused legal recognition of same-sex marriage and left the matter to Parliament.

new.s: Under the 2019 Act, offences such as forced labour or abuse of transgender persons carry imprisonment of:
new.x: Offences under the 2019 Act carry 6 months to 2 years plus fine, criticised as lighter than for similar crimes against women.

new.s: The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 came into force on:
new.x: The 2019 Act came into force on 10 January 2020.

new.s: Under the 2019 Act, a revised certificate of identity is issued by the District Magistrate:
o: After one year of the first certificate
new.x: The DM issues the certificate of identity and a revised certificate after surgery.

new.s: The National Council for Transgender Persons is chaired by the:
o: Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment
new.x: The Union Social Justice and Empowerment Minister is the ex officio chairperson of NCTP, not the PM.

new.s: The term of non-official members of the National Council for Transgender Persons is:
new.x: Non-official members of NCTP, constituted on 21 August 2020, hold office for 3 years.

new.s: Under the Transgender Persons Rules 2020, an application for a certificate of identity is made through the:
new.x: The Rules 2020 route the certificate application through the National Portal.

new.s: As per the Economic Survey 2025-26, how many Garima Greh shelter homes run in how many States/UTs?
new.x: There are 23 Garima Grehs in 17 States/UTs.

new.s: The outlay of the SMILE umbrella scheme is:
new.x: SMILE (2022, MoSJE) is a Central Sector umbrella scheme with an outlay of Rs 365 crore.

new.s: Laxmi Narayan Tripathi was the first transgender person from the Asia-Pacific to:
new.x: Laxmi Narayan Tripathi was the first from the Asia-Pacific to address the UN General Assembly.

new.s: As per Census 2011, which State had the highest number of transgender persons?
new.x: Census 2011 counted about 4.88 lakh transgender persons, the most in Uttar Pradesh, followed by undivided AP.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh has issued about how many transgender certificates via the National Portal?
new.x: AP has issued about 3,125 certificates via the National Portal and has a State Transgender Policy 2025.

new.s: The National Social Assistance Programme rests on which Articles of the Constitution?
new.x: NSAP rests on Articles 41 and 42; 'invalidity and old age pensions' is Concurrent List Entry 24.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Senior Citizens Act, 2007:
1. The Maintenance Tribunal works at sub-division level.
2. The maximum maintenance is Rs 10,000 per month.
3. The 2019 Amendment Bill removing the cap has been enacted.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the 2019 Amendment Bill lapsed, so the Rs 10,000 cap remains.

new.s: Which State enacted the first law for maintenance of parents, in 2001?
new.x: The Himachal Pradesh Maintenance of Parents and Dependents Act, 2001 preceded the central Act of 2007.

new.s: Under the National Policy on Older Persons, 1999, an older person is one aged:
new.x: NPOP 1999 defines an older person as one aged 60 years or above.

new.s: Which policy focused on elderly women and 'ageing in place'?
new.x: The National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011 focuses on elderly women and ageing in place.

new.s: The SACRED portal for senior citizens is meant for:
new.x: The SACRED portal helps senior citizens find re-employment.

new.s: The Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana provides BPL senior citizens with:
new.x: RVY gives physical aids to BPL seniors; it was launched on 1 April 2017 at Nellore.

new.s: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (2021) is an umbrella of how many components?
new.x: AVYAY (2021, MoSJE) is an umbrella of four components.
